final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages) SELECT ea.event_name, ea.average_amount, ea.average_amount - o.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, ea.average_amount / o.overall_average AS ratio_to_overall FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.overall_average
